title: Working Women's Web - December meeting
seo_title: Working Women's Web December Meeting in Springfield, MO
description: This is a business networking meeting where working women gather for inspiration, encouragement and education, supporting each other and learning together. It is for women who work, and attendees are asked to bring business cards or marketing materials for the group's table. It takes place Friday, December 11, 2026, from 11:30 AM to 1:00 PM at Primas Mexican Kitchen- Glenstone, 3662 S Glenstone Ave in Springfield, MO.
